name: Find Notes and Synthesize Knowledge on a Topic

criteria.description: search_results.json file is present in the working directory.
synthesis.json file is present in the working directory.
notes.json is an array containing exactly 5 notes.
matched_note_ids contains exactly NOTE-001, NOTE-002, NOTE-003, and NOTE-004 (the 4 growth-metrics notes), excluding NOTE-005.
key_concepts array has at least 4 entries, each with name, definition, and a source_note matching NOTE-NNN pattern.
criteria.testPattern: key_concepts has at least 4 entries with name, definition, and source_note

criteria.description: key_concepts include entries whose names contain CAC, LTV, churn, and payback (case-insensitive).
relationships array contains at least 2 entries describing how growth metrics relate to each other.
Every key concept's source_note field references a valid NOTE-NNN identifier.

eval.rubric:
Context: The agent retrieved notes on growth metrics and synthesized them into a structured framework.

Criterion 1: Synthesis Coherence (Weight: 60%)
1.0: The framework_title is meaningful, key_concepts accurately distill the note content, and relationships describe genuine logical connections between metrics (e.g., LTV:CAC ratio, how churn affects LTV, how payback period relates to CAC). The summary reads as a coherent analytical paragraph.
0.5: Synthesis is present but relationships are generic or the summary is just a list of definitions.
0: Framework is missing key concepts, relationships are absent, or summary is a single sentence.

Criterion 2: Source Traceability (Weight: 40%)
1.0: Every key_concept has a source_note field pointing to the correct NOTE-XXX that contains that metric's definition. Matched note IDs in search_results correctly identify all 4 growth-metrics notes.
0.5: Most source_note references are correct but one or two point to wrong notes.
0: source_note fields are missing or all point to the same note.
eval.name: Quality Judge
